svg.title: Interactive PicoClaw pull-request lifecycle gate map
svg.desc: A gate-first action-flow diagram for the fourteen configurable PR lifecycle decision points. Every numbered gate is a link to its editor. The map also shows user, PicoClaw agents, Git and GitHub effects, conditional branches, nudging loops, deferred work, and the separate non-configurable hard-scope invariant.

g.text: Action flow, authority boundaries, and all 14 configurable decision points in the built-in Default profile
Click or focus any gate to edit it
PicoClaw · one PR workspace and gate ledger
One charter, frozen evidence, shared corrections, profile revision, subject digest, and publication audit trail
REVIEW ≠ BRANCH ≠ ISSUE · RECOVERY IS SEPARATE
Review agent scans every changed hunk
2–5 extra rounds · variants track novel yield
review findings ready → independently offer review publication
defer S2/S3 follow-up; never silently implement
pinned candidate · shared corrections · edit authority digest
missing work? extra work? fully done?
revise or missing work → repair, re-audit, revalidate
only if provider outcome is unknown
unlock for a new deliberate request
corrections feed prompts without granting Git or gate authority

g.text: A profile maps a decision point to an ordered ALL-OF stage workflow. Any non-pass stops later stages; a missing workflow falls back to HUMAN.
suspend for an explicit user outcome
cards above show current default first stage
Every result binds profile revision + frozen subject digest + evidence.
The red hard-scope invariant shares the implementation-scope boundary, but it is not a fifteenth configurable profile gate and cannot be bypassed.
